description: This Java class defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) called AttachmentDto for representing attachment metadata within an email management system, including fields for id, email ID, filename, content type, size, and creation timestamp, along with corresponding getters and setters.

classes.name: AttachmentDto
classes.description: DTO class for attachment metadata, including fields for id, emailId, filename, contentType, size, createdAt, with constructors, getters, and setters.
